opening.text: I'm a 28-year-old army instructor who came back from active duty in Iraq three months ago. I've had a hard time adjusting to life back home after my military service. These problems started roughly seven weeks ago, after I got back. I keep having disturbing flashbacks, and I'm intensely afraid of loud noises because they remind me of what I went through in Iraq. It got so bad that I took leave from my army instructor duties. I've been having upsetting dreams, feeling very anxious, and constantly alert and on edge.
